decision: Two brands + one chapter + two open seats
essence: koine (the git for knowledge) and pinakes (the npm) are the founded brands; sphragis is the signing chapter; standing/the call door has no brand yet

decision: The koine anatomy v0 is koine's entry
essence: three floors (tree, grammar, memory), five laws; sidecars are .koine/, not .noe/ — the vendor's syllable stays out of an open standard

decision: The passenger order replaces the original sequencing
essence: koine v1 rides ordinary git repos; the reader/converter is built first; v2 becomes the vehicle where git structurally cannot follow

decision: The internal map binds: one codec, seven consumers
essence: contentChannel is the codec's live seed; koine becomes the definition of done for formats

decision: Two CLIs (koine, pin), one shared library
essence: sphragis' verbs fold into pin; the composite-CLI trigger stays written

decision: Holder org knowledgeformats, one site, no family brand
essence: the holder encodes no member count, so the open seats fit without a rename
the seats are early, never absent; a seat fires on its own trigger, never on market demand proved — the project moves ahead of the market
the chapter lands where the chain lands; the plan transforms into the seat's record and re-fires at its trigger
four domains, two npm reservations, the empty holder org; only addresses have a decaying clock
